featureAccounting: Wizard 17, total character level 17, Intelligence 20 (+5), and ordinary proficiency bonus +6 are the synthetic branch inputs; the Dissonance limit is max(4, 2+6+5)=13.

Conjuration specialization provides the rank-1 spellbook entry; Arcane Tradition provides one extra prepared Conjuration copy outside the 22 normal capacity. Conjure Rope creates an object, not a creature, so the summoned-creature HP feature has no effect.

Arcane Ward is the automatic Wizard-6 feature. After this completed preparation, Force is selected because neither prepared Conjuration spell deals damage. It resists force until the next long rest and does not mitigate the branch’s bludgeoning impacts.
Spell Efficiency is not selected in this branch; no discount permission or deadline is created. Matrix Mastery and Matrix Linking are not selected or applied.

Counterspell is automatically available from Wizard 2, costs 3 RP, uses a Reaction, and has a two-round recharge. The counter is 0/ready throughout because no attempt is made; self-counter eligibility is left unadjudicated.
Spell Tether/Tethered Cast are unused because both spell effects are non-concentration. No feature supplies another Action, cost waiver, interruption bypass, or fall mitigation.
